title: Expense Agent: Web App Experience (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Web app as UI for expense agent
Accessing and using the web experience

features.name: Web app experience for expense agent
features.description: A new intuitive, easy-to-use web portal at app.expenses.dynamics.com dedicated for employees to manage expenses without requiring Business Central licenses or accounting knowledge.
caveats: Requires administrator setup in Business Central first

features.name: No-license access model
features.description: Employees can access and use the expense agent web app with only an Enter ID without requiring a Business Central license.

features.name: Receipt capture and submission
features.description: Users can capture receipts through the web app and submit them for processing by the expense agent, with support for multiple file types including PDFs and images.

features.name: Automatic receipt data extraction
features.description: The expense agent automatically extracts important data from receipts including merchant, amount, and date information without manual entry.

features.name: Automatic expense categorization
features.description: The expense agent automatically determines the appropriate category for receipts based on receipt context, such as categorizing taxi receipts as ground transport.
caveats: Categorization can be manually edited if needed

features.name: Automatic itemization of receipts
features.description: The expense agent automatically itemizes detailed receipts (such as hotel receipts with multiple line items) based on administration settings configured in Business Central.
caveats: Items can be manually edited if necessary

features.name: Expense compliance checking
features.description: The expense agent automatically determines if expenses are compliant or non-compliant based on rules and policy settings configured by the administrator in Business Central.
caveats: Compliance is based on administrator-configured policies

features.name: Multi-category expense support
features.description: The expense agent supports multiple different types and categories of expenses including mileage, per diem, and standard receipt-based expenses.
